text:
eve-cs: AuroraHealth pilot tomorrow 09:00 PDT. They need a one-day allowlist + small QPS bump in us-east-1 for clinical partner tests. They will supply CIDRs and want auto-revoke after 24h. Renewal note: low-medium risk but AM wants a short exec summary after demo.

sam-se: CIDRs from infra: 44.210.16.0/24. Header: x-aurora-test: true. They asked for 80 QPS steady, 500 burst, duration 24h. Prefer us-east-1 only but fallback to eu-west-1 if capacity constrained.

lina-platform: I can apply. Proposed config: 80 QPS / 500 burst, token cap 40 req/s, auto_revoke 2026-04-02T16:00:00Z. Tag: cs-pilot/aurora. I'll open ticket CS-9001 before applying. Quick question: keep prefix cache ON? Customer expects dynamic prompts; recommend cache OFF to avoid stale outputs.

ryan-sre: 80 QPS looks safe. Add a soft circuit at 92% capacity to switch to tiny-quant fallback and throttle bursts. Rollback if P95 > 650ms or >4% 5xx. I'll approve once ticket is created.

eve-cs: Please notify amy@aurorahealth.com when live and include header example. AM wants ARR logged post-demo.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-9001 created. Config queued job #cfg-9122. apply-at 2026-04-01T15:45:00Z.

lina-platform: Applied to staging, smoke tests passed. Rolling to prod now.

ryan-sre: Prod apply done. Allowlist and qps bump live in us-east-1. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-04-02T16:00:00Z. Monitoring for latency/5xx; will alert if thresholds hit.

eve-cs: Thanks team. Post-demo: capture sample prompts/responses and brief the AM on next steps for Dedicated if they request higher sustained capacity.
